readerCopy.body: Being good at an old role can make it much harder to admit that the future no longer belongs to it. When the Sun squares the North Node, recognition and forward movement create friction, allowing praise, promotion, or another chance to lead to reward the exact identity that has become difficult to outgrow. The tension is strong because the old role may be succeeding. The next direction becomes clearer once the value of the recognition is separated from the question of which role deserves to keep being repeated.
